note: Which land mass a place stands on, for a journey over the ground, and how a car gets from one to the next. Filed by country, with boxes (land mass, country, south, north, west, east) for islands that belong to a country filed elsewhere. Made for this skill from the map, as a warning and not an authority: a country of many islands counts as one piece unless a box says otherwise, small islands are not listed, and nothing here knows of a closed border or a road that is shut. 'crossings' are car-carrying links with a source each: minutes on board, minutes to be there before, and the two ports as town points good to a few kilometres. A crossing not listed may still exist: search for it. The live map and the operator's page decide.

sources.LeShuttle: leshuttle.com, 'On the day', read 2026-11-12: cars ride a shuttle train through the Channel Tunnel between Folkestone and Calais, 35 minutes; aim to arrive at the terminal at least 1 hour before departure. 'Driving to Calais': the Dover to Calais ferry takes 90 minutes at its quickest
sources.Direct Ferries: directferries.co.uk, read 2026-11-12. 'Holyhead - Dublin': around 3 hours 15 minutes; Irish Ferries check-in 30 minutes before departure, Stena Line 45 minutes for cars. 'Barcelona - Palma': around 7 hours 15 minutes; Balearia 90 minutes before with a vehicle. 'Athens (Piraeus) - Heraklion': 9 hours 30 minutes on average; Minoan Lines at least 1 hour before. A booking site quoting the operators, not an operator's own page
sources.Stena Line timetable: Stena Line Cairnryan - Belfast timetable of 17 February 2025 as published by Dumfries and Galloway Council, read 2026-11-12: sailings of 2 hours 15 minutes (07:30 to 09:45); latest check-in 45 minutes for vehicles
sources.Traghettilines: traghettilines.it, 'Traghetti Messina Villa San Giovanni', read 2026-11-12: Caronte & Tourist, about 20 minutes, round the clock; arrive at the port at least 30 minutes before. A booking site, not the operator
sources.Interislander: interislander.co.nz, 'Ferry timetable', read 2026-11-12: allow three and a half hours for the sailing between Wellington and Picton. Vehicle check-in at least 60 minutes before departure, as quoted by newzealand.com.au's Interislander questions
sources.AFerry: aferry.com, read 2026-11-12. 'Hakodate to Aomori': Tsugaru Kaikyo Ferry, around 3 hours 40 minutes; check-in 90 minutes before departure. 'Civitavecchia to Olbia': around 7 hours 24 minutes; vehicles check in 90 minutes before. 'Livorno Bastia': around 4 hours 28 minutes; Corsica Ferries, vehicles at least 60 minutes before. A booking site, not the operator
sources.Spirit of Tasmania: spiritoftasmania.com.au, the operator's own site, read 2026-11-12: check-in closes strictly 45 minutes before departure; its schedule shows a day sailing leaving Geelong at 08:30 and reaching Devonport at 19:00, and its guide gives arrival as usually 9 to 11 hours after departure
sources.Marine Atlantic: marineatlantic.ca travel advisories, the operator's own site, read 2026-11-12: check-in is two hours before the scheduled departure. The crossing between North Sydney and Port aux Basques takes 6 to 8 hours, from novascotia.com's page on arriving by sea
sources.britishcolumbia.com: britishcolumbia.com, BC Ferries Tsawwassen - Swartz Bay, read 2026-11-12: sailing time 1 hour 35 minutes. Arrive 45 to 60 minutes before the sailing, as vancouverplanner.com recommends. Neither is the operator's own page
sources.Wikipedia, Darien Gap: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Darien_Gap, read 2026-11-12: the gap interrupts the Pan-American Highway, which breaks at Yaviza in Panama and resumes at Turbo in Colombia, roughly 106 km away

crossings.name: the shuttle train through the Channel Tunnel
crossings.why: Great Britain has no road to the mainland. A car crosses on the shuttle train through the Channel Tunnel, between Folkestone and Calais, or on a ferry
crossings.more: the quickest ferry is 90 min on board
